correctness.rationale: For any nonempty disjoint-union family of Theta-models, two components supply U-witnesses with no cross-edge, so Theta remains true. On explicit size-3 A and size-4 B models, direct evaluation gives Theta(A)=true and Theta(B)=false. All existential/two-way-guarded-universal formulas are preserved by induced embeddings whose images are both predecessor- and successor-closed, by induction on formula structure; every B-root lies in one of two such copies of A. Hence no candidate forall x alpha is equivalent to Theta even on finite frames. The finite executable checks (155236 union pairs and 15000 seeded grammar instances) independently exercise but do not replace these arguments.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a negative answer to an explicitly stated 2026 open equality-free preservation question, with one binary relation and explicit small witnesses. Its explanation in terms of rootwise neighborhood-closed induced embeddings identifies a structural limit of existential/two-way-guarded-universal normal forms. This is not merely a numerical improvement, and the claim is independent of the finite enumeration checker.
